description: Read complete retained evidence from a free audit run, including full AI answers, sources, product records and findings. Discovers named collections, then returns selected records with explicit pagination and availability. Reads only; never starts collection or spends audit allowance.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

limit.description: Integer from 1 to 100 child records. Strings use 10,000-character pages.

offset.description: Non-negative integer; use the previous page’s nextOffset.

recordId.description: A returned JSON-pointer record id; maximum 2,000 characters.

runId.description: A returned run id, from 1 to 100 characters.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: read_audit_evidence
title: Read audit evidence
